UP CM Yogi Adityanath challenges Akhilesh Yadav on Krishna Janmabhoomi

Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has engaged in a war of words with Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav. The exchange began when Yadav spoke about making Ayodhya a religious city. Adityanath responded by challenging Yadav to initiate a movement for the Krishna Janmabhoomi, similar to the Ram Mandir movement, and questioned his stance on religious sites.
